summary: WA9036SOF19 swing-out enclosure accessory arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: WA9036SOF19 is the drawing identifier for swing-out enclosure accessory in AutomationDirect's Enclosure Accessories collection. A swing-out accessory supports the selected moving internal enclosure arrangement. Its drawing does not define a complete equipment-carrying panel by itself.

For example, in a cabinet where an internal panel must open for maintenance, use the WA9036SOF19 reference to coordinate hinged interface, panel support and operating sweep. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/WA9036SOF19.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
